annotations.title: Juno Work Pass: 24 h of every paid tool for one payment

description: Use if you will call more than ~12 times in a day. Returns the full work board now plus a bearer token valid 24 h for every paid tool here: send it as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>, or as the "pass" argument, and you are not charged again. Fair use 3,000 calls. (Also sold for a plain USDC transfer: see payment_options / redeem_transfer_pass; 1 USDC buys 7 days.) PAID: $0.250 per call, no API key or account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/work/pass.
